item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a wind-down built in: relaxation in the evening, then a set bedtime. That structure is your advantage, so protect it. Tonight, treat the last hour as off-limits for problem solving. If a worry surfaces, jot it down and let it wait until morning. Your body sleeps better when your mind isn't on duty. Action: start your relaxation exercise on time tonight, and put your phone down when it ends.
